Jasmine Kaur  
📍 Mumbai, India | 📞 +91 9876543210 | 📧 jasmin.kaur@nexgentech.com | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/jasminekaurml  

A results-oriented machine learning engineer with a passion for building scalable solutions that drive operational efficiency. Over the past two years, I’ve focused on developing production-grade models, refining feature pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful outcomes. My work has centered on leveraging cutting-edge NLP techniques and cloud-native tools to solve complex enterprise challenges, with a particular emphasis on deploying models that balance accuracy and real-world applicability.  

Technical Skills  
Proficient in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face Transformers. Specialized in building and deploying NLP models for tasks such as sentiment analysis, text classification, and intent recognition. Experienced in designing scalable inference pipelines using MLflow and integrating models into REST APIs. Familiar with cloud platforms like AWS, where I’ve contributed to deploying machine learning workflows and optimizing cloud resource utilization. Skilled in containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes, enabling seamless model deployment across dev and production environments. Comfortable working with lightweight ETL processes and leveraging Spark for distributed data processing.  

Professional Experience  
At NexGen Technologies, I’ve focused on delivering end-to-end machine learning solutions that align with business objectives. My work includes developing a real-time fraud detection system using PyTorch, which reduced false positives by 18% through iterative model refinement. I also designed a feature store infrastructure that streamlined data access for multiple teams, cutting down preprocessing time by 30%. Collaborating with DevOps, I ensured smooth model deployment on AWS, achieving a 25% improvement in inference latency.  

During my internship at InnovateAI Corp, I contributed to a prototype NLP model for customer support automation. Using Hugging Face Transformers, I fine-tuned a BERT-based model to handle multilingual queries, improving response accuracy by 22%. The model was later deployed via MLflow, allowing for version control and reproducible experiments. I also optimized inference pipelines to reduce latency, which was critical for handling high-volume user interactions.  

Earlier, as a Data Analyst Intern at GlobalTech Solutions, I supported data cleaning efforts and created visualizations that informed key decisions. This role introduced me to the nuances of working with unstructured data, which later shaped my approach to NLP projects.  

Education  
Master of Science in Data Science, University of Toronto (2022). Thesis focused on improving model interpretability in high-stakes NLP applications, with a particular emphasis on ethical considerations in automated decision-making.  

Projects  
Developed a sentiment analysis model for social media monitoring, achieving 91% F1 score on a custom dataset. The model was integrated into a REST API, enabling real-time analysis of user feedback.  
Built a multilingual chatbot using Hugging Face Transformers, which handled 15+ languages and reduced customer support response time by 20%.  
Optimized a PyTorch-based recommendation system for a retail client, improving click-through rates by 12% through hyperparameter tuning and feature engineering.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Punjabi (native)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as Top Performer at InnovateAI Corp for contributions to NLP model deployment. Received a merit-based scholarship for my master’s thesis on ethical AI.
